name: calibre
description_en: The official source code repository for the calibre ebook manager
readme_excerpt: calibre calibre is an e-book manager. It can view, convert, edit and catalog e-books in all of the major e-book formats. It can also talk to e-book reader devices. It can go out to the internet and fetch metadata for your books. It can download newspapers and convert them into e-books for convenient reading.
